newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam believes inflation may be too low.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam believes inflation may be too low.

text.p: Vietnam believes that inflation should be kept at a certain level to protect producers and businessmen, a Foreign Ministry spokesman said on Thursday.
He was commenting at a briefing for reporters on data which have shown four consecutive months of declining inflation.
The latest figures, for August, put the annual inflation rate at 3.2 percent compared with 18.4 percent a year earlier.
"...the government thinks that there should be measures to keep inflation stable at a certain level so that it doesn't cause difficulties for producers and businessmen," the spokesman said.
He said the drop in consumer prices had already caused some difficulties for production in commodity-based industries.
